summary: Fast Track Group, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing it withdrew its appeal of Nasdaq's August 11, 2026 Staff Determination to delist its Class A ordinary shares, cancelling the September 17, 2026 hearing; Nasdaq will file a Form 25-NSE with the SEC, effective ten days after filing. Shares have been suspended from Nasdaq trading since August 18, 2026, and now quote OTC under FTRKD. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. Watch OTC liquidity, compliance with OTC disclosure standards, and any reverse-split or relisting risk-arb angle.
